decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options based on sound quality reputation, durability (waterproofing), and battery life. My consideration set included a range from budget-friendly (INSMY) to high-end home audio (Sonos) and premium portable brands (Bose, B&O, Sony). I ultimately selected the Sony SRS-XB43 because it offers a superior 24-hour battery life and an IP67 waterproof/dustproof rating at a mid-range price point of $156.34, providing a better balance of performance and ruggedness than the similarly priced Bose or more expensive Bang & Olufsen.
